faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Danaël, in one place.

items.general_1_a: Danaël is a school platform that connects students, teachers, parents and schools around modern, engaging tracking — built for the Cameroonian context.
items.general_2_a: Yes, a free account is available for students and parents. Premium and school plans exist to unlock advanced features.
items.general_3_a: Danaël is available in French and English, with French as the default.
items.account_1_q: How do I create an account?
items.account_1_a: Click "Sign up", choose your profile (student, parent, teacher or school) and follow the onboarding steps.
items.account_2_a: You can create multiple profiles with different emails, but a single account cannot change roles after sign-up.
items.billing_1_q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.billing_1_a: We accept MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money and bank cards.
items.billing_2_a: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time from your billing dashboard. Access remains active until the end of the paid period.
items.schools_1_q: How do I sign up my school?
items.schools_1_a: Use the contact form and check "Request a demo for my school". Our team will contact you within 24 hours to schedule a demo.
items.schools_2_q: Is there a student limit per school?
items.schools_2_a: No, the school plan has unlimited students. Pricing depends on the features enabled.
items.privacy_1_a: Yes, all data is encrypted and stored on secure servers. We are GDPR-compliant and follow Cameroonian data protection law.
items.privacy_2_a: Only you, your teachers and your parents (if you're a student) can see your grades. No data is shared with third parties.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Danaël supports you at every step, from sign-up to success.

steps.step1Description: Sign up for free in less than 2 minutes with your email. Choose your profile (student, parent, teacher or school) to access a tailored space.
steps.step2Description: Join your class or school with an invitation code, add your subjects and customize your goals. Parents link their account to their child's.
steps.step3Description: Do your homework, take quizzes, earn badges and track your progress. Teachers create content, parents get alerts, schools run their institution.
steps.step4Description: Measure your progress, join contests, unlock badges and reach your goals. Danaël celebrates every win with you.

howItWorks.ctaSubtitle: Create your free account in less than 2 minutes.

testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.subtitle: Read what people using Danaël every day have to say.

items.1_content: Danaël helped me organize my work. Badges motivate me to do homework on time, and I can see my progress clearly.
items.2_content: I get alerts as soon as my son's grade drops. I can chat with his teachers without traveling. Essential.
items.3_content: Creating a quiz takes 5 minutes and grading is automatic. I save 3 hours a week and can see exactly where each student gets stuck.
items.4_content: We deployed Danaël across the whole school. Student engagement jumped, parents are better informed, and our teachers are relieved.
items.5_content: I love the inter-class contests! It pushes me to revise more often. And the library has everything I need for homework.
items.6_content: My son is more motivated since he started using Danaël. Badges and gamification turn homework into a fun challenge.

legal.title: Terms of Use
legal.intro: These terms of use (TOU) govern the use of the Danaël platform (hereafter "the Platform") published by Danaël SARL.

sections.1_content: These TOU define the terms of use of the Platform by users, as well as the rights and obligations of each party.
sections.2_content: The user agrees to provide accurate information when signing up. The account is personal and cannot be transferred. The user is responsible for keeping their credentials safe.
sections.3_content: The user agrees to use the Platform in accordance with its purpose and applicable law. Any abusive, fraudulent or immoral use is strictly prohibited.
sections.4_content: Danaël collects and processes personal data in accordance with its privacy policy. The user has a right of access, rectification and deletion of their data.
sections.5_content: The Platform and its content (texts, images, logos) are protected by intellectual property law. Any reproduction without authorization is prohibited.
sections.6_content: Danaël makes every effort to ensure Platform availability but cannot be held liable for interruptions due to force majeure or third parties.
sections.7_content: Danaël reserves the right to modify these TOU at any time. Changes take effect upon publication on the Platform.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy describes how Danaël collects, uses and protects users' personal data.

sections.1_content: We collect: name, email, role (student, parent, teacher, school), activity data (assignments, quizzes, grades) and navigation data (cookies).
sections.2_content: Data is used to provide the service, improve the user experience, communicate with the user and meet legal obligations.
sections.3_content: Data processing is based on: contract performance, user consent and compliance with legal obligations.
sections.4_content: Data is kept during the period of use of the service and 3 years after the last activity, unless early deletion is requested.
sections.5_content: Data is never sold. It may be shared with our technical providers (hosting, payments) strictly as needed for the service.
sections.6_content: You have a right of access, rectification, erasure, portability and objection. To exercise them, write to privacy@danael.app.
sections.7_content: All data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest. Access is strictly limited to authorized personnel.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This policy describes the cookies used by the Danaël Platform and how to manage them.

sections.1_content: A cookie is a small file placed on your device when visiting a website. It is used to store information about your browsing.
sections.2_content: Danaël uses essential cookies (session, language, theme) and analytical cookies (anonymized audience measurement). No advertising cookies are used.
sections.3_content: You can manage or delete cookies from your browser settings. Essential cookies are necessary for the Platform to function properly.
sections.4_content: Essential cookies are kept for a maximum of 13 months. Analytical cookies are kept for 13 months.
